I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the ticket is #8841.

It comes from his own message in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13). There he said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it on ticket #8841 for support. He's a member of that channel, so this is information he could already see.

In a direct message earlier, he gave me a private guess about what the ticket number might become. I left that guess out of the channel reply.
